resources.string: One phone shares its screen. The other sees it live and can tap, swipe and type on it.
Let another phone see and control this screen.
View a phone that\'s sharing and use it from here.
On the phone you want to control, open DroidLink and tap Share this phone.
On the other phone, tap Control another phone and pick it from the list, or type its address.
Enter the 6-digit PIN shown on the sharing phone.
Both phones need to be on the same Wi-Fi. No Wi-Fi? Turn on one phone\'s hotspot and join it with the other.
Lets the other phone tap, swipe and type here. Without it, the other phone can only watch.
In the list, open DroidLink remote control and switch it on. If Android says it\'s a restricted setting, open App info, tap ⋮ in the top corner, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
When you start, Android asks for permission to record your screen. On the other phone, open DroidLink, tap Control another phone and enter:
When you start, Android asks for permission to record your screen. Choose Entire screen if it asks.
Waiting for the other phone to connect…
No Wi-Fi found. Connect both phones to the same Wi-Fi, or turn on this phone\'s hotspot.
Only share with people you trust. While connected, the other phone can see everything on your screen.
Shown while this phone is shared with another phone.

Lets a phone you connect with DroidLink tap, swipe and type on this phone while you are sharing your screen. DroidLink only acts on instructions from a phone that entered your PIN, and only while sharing is on.
Looking for phones sharing on this Wi-Fi…
The address and PIN appear on the other phone after it taps Start sharing.
Enter the address shown on the other phone
View only · remote control is off on the other phone
Turn on Remote control on the other phone to tap and swipe.
You\'ll stop seeing and controlling the other phone.
Wrong PIN. Check the PIN on the other phone and try again.
That phone is already connected to another phone.
The other phone has a different version of DroidLink. Install the same version on both.
Couldn\'t reach %1$s. Check that both phones are on the same Wi-Fi and that sharing is on.
Home on the other phone. Long-press for notifications
Recent apps on the other phone
